prompt: Create a bright, high-detail anime portrait of a cheerful young woman in a summery street-fashion outfit. She has very long flowing platinum white hair with soft windblown strands, large sparkling blue eyes, fair skin, a blush, and an open smiling expression. Add an elegant floral hair arrangement on the right side of her head made of cream-white blossoms and small baby’s-breath sprigs, plus delicate dangling flower earrings. She is posed in a lively three-quarter view, upper body to mid-thigh, one hand lifted near her cheek as if waving or playfully posing, looking directly at the viewer. Dress her in a dark charcoal off-shoulder blouse with large white polka dots, with ruffled elastic trim around the neckline and sleeve cuffs, slightly loose fabric, and a small coral-red ribbon accent near the chest. Pair it with a white cargo mini skirt featuring visible patch pockets, seams, belt loops, and a clean fitted waist. The background is an outdoor sunny city street rendered with soft bokeh, pale blue sky, blurred buildings, and warm summer light; frame the scene with a few pale pink and white flowers along the right edge. Use a polished Japanese anime illustration style with delicate linework, luminous pastel coloring, soft rim light, airy highlights, flowing hair motion, shallow depth of field, and a fresh morning atmosphere. Vertical portrait composition, 2:3 aspect ratio, no text, no watermark, no extra characters.
